section_summary.extract_value: This section reports that participants completed a Bahasa Malaysia translation of the BAS-2 (Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b), a 10-item measure with items rated on a 5-point scale from 1 (never; Malay: tidak pernah) to 5 (always; Malay: sentiasa). The translational procedure is described elsewhere in the paper and the items in English and Malay are reported in Table 1. No sample characteristics, BMI assessment, or correlations with BMI are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Participants completed a Bahasa Malaysia (Malay) translation of the BAS-2 (Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b). This is a 10-item measure in which items were rated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (never; Malay: tidak pernah) to 5 (Always; Malay: sentiasa). The translational procedure is described below and the items in English and Malay are reported in Table 1."
